data.name: Annissa
data.gender_notes: Annissa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Anna, meaning 'grace' or 'favor'. This name was borne by several saints, including St. Annissa, a martyr in Thessalonica. In the New Testament, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, was a prophetess who lived in the temple and recognized Jesus as the Messiah. The name Annissa carries the meaning “Grace, Favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Annissa usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's grace and favor.
data.etymology: Annissa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Annissa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אניסה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אניסה נגזר מהמילה העברית 'חסד' שפירושה חסד, טובת ה' והאהבה שלו לאנושות. השם מתאר את טובת ה' ואת חסדו הגלוי על האנושות, ומבטא את התקווה והאמון בחסדו של אלוהים לטובה ולרחמים.

in_greek.name: Αννίσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Ἀννίσα συγγενεύει μὲ τὴν ἑλληνικὴ λέξη 'χάρις' ποὺ σημαίνει χάρη, εὐδοκία καὶ ἀγαθότητα. Ἡ ὀνομασία ἀπεικονίζει τὴν εὐδοκιὰ καὶ τὴν ἀγαθότητα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ποὺ ἔχει φανερωθεὶ εἰς ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἐκφράζει τὴν πίστιν εἰς τὴν ἀγαθότητα καὶ τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ Κυρίου.

in_latin.name: Annissa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Annissa derivatur ex voce Latina 'gratia' quae gratiam, favorem et bonitatem significat. Nomen hoc gratiam Dei et bonitatem Domini nostri Iesu Christi repraesentat, quae in nos effusa est, et spem ac fidem in eius misericordia et amore exprimit.

Historically, names with similar roots have been used to signify the divine favor and benevolence. Annissa symbolizes a person's spiritual connection to God's mercy and grace.
